items.example: We met at university and became friends.
items.mnemonic: Митинг знакомств: meet somebody at university — познакомиться с кем-то.

items.example: After they finished university they got married.
items.mnemonic: Мэрия женит: get married after university — пожениться.

items.example: He grew up in a small town.
items.mnemonic: Мальчик вырос под гром: grow up in a town — вырасти.

items.example: He left school at sixteen and started work.
items.mnemonic: В ливень уходят leave school — уйти из школы.

items.example: She did well at school and got a scholarship.
items.mnemonic: Велосипед за успехи: do well at school — хорошо учиться.

items.example: Their app made a lot of money in a year.
items.mnemonic: Мания денег: make a lot of money — заработать много денег.

items.example: She bought her parents a new house.
items.mnemonic: Дом на Байкале: buy somebody a new house — купить кому-то новый дом.

items.example: They fell in love at university and married in 2019.
items.mnemonic: Пара на лавке fall in love — влюбиться.

items.example: He changed his mind and stayed at the same company.
items.mnemonic: Мина в голове: change one's mind — передумать.

items.example: The twins are very similar — they both love the sea.
items.mnemonic: Близнецы как одна семья: be similar to — быть похожим.

items.example: How often did you speak to each other?
items.mnemonic: Афиша спрашивает how often did you speak — как часто ты говорил.

items.example: What were you like when you were ten?
items.mnemonic: Лайк десятилетнему: what were you like at ten — каким ты был в десять.
